annotation.title_clean: New report and guidelines for indigenous data sovereignty in artificial intelligence developments
annotation.title_en: New report and guidelines for indigenous data sovereignty in artificial intelligence developments
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item announcing a report and guidelines on indigenous-people-centred AI in Latin America and the Caribbean. It urges participatory inclusion, indigenous data sovereignty, free prior and informed consent, and protection of intellectual property, and highlights five Mexican language and cultural AI projects.
key_provisions_or_claims: Report urges participatory inclusion of indigenous communities in all phases of AI development
Digitization of indigenous data must respect self-determination and data governance rights
Free, prior and informed consent, privacy and IP rights required
Proposes public policies integrating indigenous perspectives
Presents five Mexican best-practice AI projects on indigenous languages and textiles
